origin.description: Locate the first literal match in each string.
origin.usage: stri_locate_first_fixed(str, pattern, get_length = FALSE, ..., opts_fixed = NULL)

arguments.name: str
arguments.text: Character vector of strings to search.

arguments.name: get_length
arguments.text: If TRUE, the second column is the match length. A miss is then -1.

origin.details: Indexes are 1-based and inclusive, counted in code points. The columns are start and end. Two NAs mean no match, or a missing argument. An empty string is NA, NA, or -1, -1 when get_length is TRUE. A missing string stays NA even when get_length is TRUE. A missing opts_fixed uses case-sensitive search without overlap. A dict may set case_insensitive and overlap. Case-insensitive search maps each code point with ICU u_toupper. A character whose uppercase form is longer than one code point is left unchanged, so ß does not match SS.
origin.value: An integer matrix with columns start and end, or start and length.
origin.example:
loc <- stri_locate_first_fixed("ababa", "aba")
cat(paste0('stri_locate_first_fixed("ababa", "aba") starts at ', loc[1, 1], ' and ends at ', loc[1, 2], '.\n'))

translation.description: Locate the first literal match in each string.
translation.usage: stri_locate_first_fixed(str, pattern, get_length=False, opts_fixed=None, case_insensitive=None, overlap=None)

arguments.name: str
arguments.text: String, missing value, or list of those.

arguments.name: pattern
arguments.text: Literal pattern, missing value, or list of those.

arguments.name: get_length
arguments.text: If true, the second column is the match length. A miss is then -1.

arguments.name: opts_fixed
arguments.text: None, or a dict of search settings. Overlap is ignored.

arguments.name: case_insensitive
arguments.text: If given, match the simple uppercase of each code point.

arguments.name: overlap
arguments.text: Ignored, as in the installed function.

translation.details: Indexes are 1-based and inclusive, counted in code points. Each row is start and end. Two NAs mean no match, or a missing argument. An empty string is NA, NA, or -1, -1 when get_length is true. A missing string stays NA even when get_length is true. A missing opts_fixed uses case-sensitive search without overlap. A dict may set case_insensitive and overlap. Case-insensitive search maps each code point with ICU u_toupper. A character whose uppercase form is longer than one code point is left unchanged, so ß does not match SS.
translation.value: A list of rows. Each row is start and end, or start and length.
translation.example:
from stringi.fixed import stri_locate_first_fixed
loc = stri_locate_first_fixed("ababa", "aba")
print(f'stri_locate_first_fixed("ababa", "aba") starts at {loc[0][0]} and ends at {loc[0][1]}.')
